desc: lock/寄存器锁定位在运行时条件下被写入（数据通路可直接改写安全配置），需人工确认写者是否经过权限校验
desc_en: Lock/security-config register bit written under runtime conditions (data path can directly rewrite secure config) - verify the write path is privilege-checked. Needs human review.

desc: lock/寄存器锁定位在 case 分支中被写入，需人工确认分支条件是否包含权限校验
desc_en: Lock/security-config register bit written inside a case branch - check whether the branch condition includes an authorization check. Needs human review.

desc: 调试/测试/扫描类信号（jtag、debug、scan、test）参与条件且控制涉及 lock 类变量的赋值（含索引写入，如 reglock_mem[j]）—— 锁定位可能被非正常路径解锁，需人工确认
desc_en: Debug/test/scan-family signal (jtag/debug/scan/test) takes part in the condition while the branch rewrites lock-family registers - lock control may be reachable from debug mode.

desc: lock 类信号参与条件且分支中改写 lock/受保护配置类（*_cfg）寄存器（含索引写入）—— 锁定状态机可能未覆盖所有解锁路径，需人工确认
desc_en: Lock-family signal in the condition while the branch rewrites lock/protected-config (*_cfg) registers - check whether this lock-update path misses a debug-privilege guard.

desc: 同一 if 条件中同时出现调试类信号（debug/scan/test/jtag）与 lock 类信号 —— 调试态可绕过锁定保护（对应 VerilogLAVD 论文 Fig.4 官方 TDP 的可用原语转写）
desc_en: Same if condition contains a debug-family signal (debug/scan/test/jtag) AND a lock-family signal, with lock writes in the branch (paper Fig.4 TDP) - lock state may be tampered via the debug interface.

desc: 连续赋值（assign）直接引用 key/secret 类敏感数据 —— 密钥可能被无门控地暴露到任意读取方，需人工确认（词法启发式）
desc_en: Continuous assignment (assign) directly reads key/secret-family sensitive data - the key may be exposed to untrusted functions. Needs human review.

desc: 连续赋值（assign）同时读取权限类（priv/auth/perm/access）与口令类（pwd/pass/pin）信号 —— 授权判断可能混淆，需人工确认（词法启发式）
desc_en: Continuous assignment reads both privilege-family (priv/auth/perm/access) and password-family (pwd/pass) data - inconsistent authorization policy. Needs human review.

desc: 调试/测试类信号参与条件且分支中存在对存储器（mem/rom/ram）的非阻塞读取 —— 调试态可能绕过授权读取受保护存储，需人工确认
desc_en: Debug/test-family signal in the condition while the branch reads memory (mem/rom/ram) via nonblocking assignment - memory access may bypass the intended authorization.

desc: case 语句分支数与判断表达式位宽的状态总数不一致（缺少状态/分支覆盖）。注意：遍历引擎无法表达『存在 default 分支』的否定判断，因此带完整 default 分支的 FSM 也会被标记 —— 对照样例中 1.v/4.v 即为已知误报，请人工确认
desc_en: Case arm count differs from 2^(selector width) - missing state/branch coverage. NOTE: the engine cannot verify the default arm, so well-formed FSMs may match. LOW severity, needs human review.

desc: if 条件中比较口令/密钥类数据（pwd/pass/pin/key/secret）且分支中存在时序赋值 —— 逐位比较等分支结构易受时序侧信道攻击，需人工确认（词法启发式）
desc_en: if condition compares password/key-family data (pwd/pass/pin/key/secret) while the branch contains timing assignments - possible timing side channel. Needs human review.

desc: 非阻塞赋值改写 key/secret 类敏感寄存器（含索引写入）—— 密钥可能未按安全生命周期管理（如未清除/未受控改写），需人工确认（词法启发式）
desc_en: Nonblocking assignment rewrites a key/secret-family sensitive register (incl. indexed writes) - the key may be exposed/overwritten without proper security control.

desc: 请求/写使能类信号（req/wr/write/load）参与条件且分支中改写 key/secret 类寄存器 —— 密钥寄存器写入可能缺少特权级校验，需人工确认
desc_en: Request/write-enable-family signal (req/wr/write/load) in the condition while the branch rewrites key/secret-family registers - key register writes may lack a privilege check.

desc: 使能类信号（en/enable）参与条件且分支中改写 lock/jtag/key 类调试或锁定寄存器 —— 调试/锁定位可能被普通使能路径初始化或篡改，需人工确认
desc_en: Enable-family signal (en/enable) in the condition while the branch rewrites lock/jtag/dbg/key-family registers - the unlock path may miss a state check (initialization-dependent).

desc: if 条件中含 key/secret 类敏感数据且分支中存在时序赋值 —— 数据依赖敏感值的分支/运算易引入时序侧信道，需人工确认（词法启发式；样例中不含敏感命名的常量时间实现会漏报）
desc_en: if condition involves key/secret-family sensitive data while the branch contains timing assignments - branch/timing behavior may depend on the secret value (timing side-channel risk).

desc: if 分支中改写 key/secret 类敏感寄存器（含索引写入，如 secret_key[addr]）—— 敏感信息可能未在不再需要时清除、或可被普通数据通路覆写，需人工确认（词法启发式）
desc_en: if branch rewrites key/secret-family sensitive registers (incl. indexed writes such as secret_key[addr]) - sensitive information may be exposed to an untrusted observer.

desc: 口令/密钥类数据（pwd/pass/pin/key）被非阻塞赋值锁存进寄存器 —— 敏感数据通路与移位结构易受时序/侧信道攻击，需人工确认（词法启发式）
desc_en: Password/key-family data (pwd/pass/pin/key) latched into a register via nonblocking assignment - the storage/comparison path may leak via structural timing (side channel).

desc: 非阻塞赋值读取 secret 类数据参与运算/锁存 —— 数据依赖秘密值的分支或运算易引入时序侧信道，需人工确认（词法启发式；不含敏感命名的常量时间实现会漏报）
desc_en: Nonblocking assignment reads secret-family data for computation/latching - branch or timing behavior may depend on the secret value (side-channel risk).

desc: 组合逻辑阻塞赋值（always @(*) 中的 =）直接引用 key/secret 类敏感数据 —— 密钥可能被无门控地暴露到任意读取方，需人工确认（词法启发式）
desc_en: Combinational blocking assignment (= inside always @(*)) directly reads key/secret-family sensitive data - the key is exposed on a combinational path.
